svg.aria-label: Quote workflow: the main session asks six scoping questions, Lucia answers, the quote builder drafts 3 600 euros, the pricing analyst and skeptic object, the builder revises to 3 500 euros

g.text: You
Lucia (you)
/office:quote one-page online ordering site for a bakery, SK + EN
…contact form to email
office · asks you
Six questions first: each moves the price by more than 20 %.
Form to email only (about 1 700 €) or pickup slots (about 3 300 €)?
Payments? An order list? Who writes the texts? Deadline?
You
Lucia (you)
Pickup slots, pay at pickup, a list for the morning shift.
Jana: 3 000 € excl. VAT, up to 3 500 €. Texts by 20 November.
quote-builder
Draft: 72 h, 3 600 €, 100 € over her ceiling.
Priced from the hours, not squeezed into the budget. Cuts are listed.
pricing-analyst
Hours are short against the florist project's actuals.
Also: Slovak VAT is 23 % since January 2025, not the 20 % in your file.
NEEDS INFO
skeptic
Cancelled orders and unpaid cakes would still get baked.
Nobody can cancel an order or free its slot: that was last December's 9 cakes.
MUST FIX
quote-builder · for the client
Phase 1: 3 500 € excl. VAT, launch 1 December.
Photos moved to an add-on, no discount. Phase 2 (500 €) adds a 'cancelled' switch.
Quote in Slovak, in ~/knowledge. Nothing was sent to Jana.
office · asks you
Only you can check: how does the site send email today?
In the repo the contact form only prints to the console.
